ValidationRule.description: Top ID required for ALM Closed Won Opps
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c ), ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed won – pending approval'), ISBLANK ( Top_ID__c ), CONTAINS(Opportunity_Owner_Team__c, 'ALM') == True, Opportunity_Owner_Team__c <> 'Events - ALM Sponsorship', Opportunity_Owner_Team__c <> 'Events - ALM Delegates' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add Top ID before pushing opp to 'Closed Won - Pending Approval'
